verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a built-in bulk-operation capability that applies one action across many items (assets, objects or scenes) at once. Scripting APIs, editor extensions, the Asset Database, `unity eval` and MCP prompts are developer building blocks or general automation, not a bulk-operations feature. Build Automation's simultaneous multi-platform builds are an adjacent build feature and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
